mapper.update: UPDATE byai_group_chat_task SET turn_status = 'RUNNING', current_turn_id = #{turnId}, current_turn_trace_id = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE task_session_id = #{taskSessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND turn_status IN ('WAITING_USER', 'FAILED')

UPDATE byai_group_chat_task SET status = 'PUBLISHED', turn_status = 'WAITING_USER', publish_message_id = #{messageId}, publish_by = #{publisherUserId}, update_time = #{now} WHERE task_session_id = #{taskSessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND turn_status != 'RUNNING'
UPDATE byai_group_chat_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = #{now} WHERE task_session_id = #{taskSessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
